title: CUU recognised at IEEE Day 2026 at the American Center
author: Branch Executive Committee
summary: On 6 October 2026, Cavendish University Uganda joined IEEE student branches from across Uganda at the American Center, Kabalagala, and received its official certificate of approval.
content:
On 6 October 2026, IEEE student branches from across Uganda celebrated IEEE Day together at the American Center in Kabalagala, Kampala. Universities present included Makerere, Kyambogo, ISBAT, UCU, Ernest Cook, MUBS, KIU and Cavendish.

Cavendish University Uganda was recognised as one of the branches being reborn and received an official certificate of approval. The day was given to engagement, sharing perspectives and networking between branches.

Next up is the Official Branch Launch on Wednesday 4 November 2026 at Cavendish University Uganda. Time and venue details will be announced soon.
